title: ⚠️ MMX confirmation gate
description: This action is safety-sensitive. Review the rules below and confirm before continuing.

rules.title: Never expose secrets
rules.text: Never expose secrets in source, logs, reports or browser state.

rules.title: Admin APIs require explicit checks
rules.text: Admin APIs require explicit authentication and permission checks.

rules.title: Use least privilege
rules.text: Use least privilege and the smallest tool scope possible.

rules.title: Reality before assumption
rules.text: Work from the actual project state and verify real conditions before changing them.

rules.title: Proof before claim
rules.text: Proof before claim: do not present an outcome as successful without validation output.

rules.title: No fake done
rules.text: A task is not complete without actual evidence and verification.

rules.title: Safety before convenience
rules.text: Security and data integrity come before speed or convenience.

systemMessage.title: Rules acknowledgment required
systemMessage.content: By confirming, you acknowledge the MMX rules above and agree to proceed only with the minimum safe action after verification.
